sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Standard text box
sections.what: Builds the text box with its border, padding, focus highlight, disabled look, and file-picker styling. It accepts overrides and passes all other settings through.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps every text box in the app identical and easy to change in one place.
sections.watch_out: The style includes a size change on medium screens, so layouts can shift when the window grows.

summary: Builds the standard single-line text box used across the app, with a border, padding, focus ring, and disabled look.
purpose: Gives every text input the same look and behavior. Screens use this instead of a plain input element.
why: Likely reason: a shared input keeps forms consistent. The code does not state this directly.
how: It imports the style helper and wraps the standard input element. It applies a long style string, merges any extra style overrides, and passes the type, ref, and other settings through. It exports the component.
inputs: Type of input, placeholder, value, change handlers, style overrides, and standard element settings.
outputs: A styled text box. Nothing is stored.
risks: Changing the shared style affects every input. A text size change on medium screens is part of the style, so it can shift layouts.
debug: If an input looks wrong, check the style string here and any overrides passed in. If typing does not work, check the value and change handler in the screen code.
